description: Every Instagram automation on this account that is not archived. Each row has its name, its state (On, Paused or Draft), the Instagram account it runs on, what starts it, and how many DMs and public replies it has sent. ends_at is when it switches itself off (null = no end), and ended is true once that time has passed. campaign is its campaign label, or null. One automation on several accounts shows one row per account, all with the same group_id.
name: sprkly_list_automations
title: List automations
